name: Jareth Thomas
title: Operations, Manufacturing & Skilled Trades Professional
summary: Reliable and hardworking operations professional with experience in manufacturing, warehouse logistics, electrical work, security, and residential repair services. Skilled in material handling, equipment operation, inventory systems, troubleshooting, and maintaining safe, efficient work environments. Proven ability to lead projects and manage operations as co-owner of MC Handyman LLC.

skills.name: Workplace Strengths
keywords: Ability to work in fast-paced environments

bullets: Co-own and operate a residential repair and property maintenance business serving local clients.
Manage scheduling, customer communication, estimates, invoicing, and project coordination.
Perform residential repair work including flooring, drywall, trim work, painting, and minor electrical repairs.
Diagnose and troubleshoot residential electrical and mechanical issues.
Coordinate materials and workflow to complete projects efficiently and to customer expectations.
Received and inspected incoming steel shipments and production coils.
Verified material information and entered receiving data into inventory systems.
Assisted with purchase order entry and material documentation.
Helped maintain accurate, organized staging areas for production materials.
Installed electrical systems in new residential construction.
Performed rough-in inspections and troubleshooting.
Conducted final electrical checks before inspection approval.
Handled warranty service calls and diagnosed electrical issues.
Cut tool steel to required specifications using industrial saw equipment.
Operated forklifts and overhead cranes to move materials safely.
Performed maintenance and preventive maintenance on shop equipment.
Configured and managed communication systems including phones and computers.
Maintained issued equipment and system reliability.
Provided IT support and monitored system performance.
Assisted with staff management and operational oversight.
Supervised shop floor operations and coordinated order workflow.
Processed order documentation and invoices using SAP.
Operated industrial saws, forklifts, and overhead cranes.
Verified completed orders before shipment.
Assembled double oven units in a production line environment.
Installed components and performed quality checks.
Unloaded delivery trucks and organized inventory.
Stocked shelves and maintained merchandise levels.
Prepared sales floor prior to store opening.
Patrolled assigned areas and monitored security posts.
Reported safety and security concerns to supervisors.
Managed inmate intake and release procedures.
Conducted security checks of holding areas.
Maintained safety and order within the county jail facility.
Provided IT support and maintained computer systems.
Assisted staff with troubleshooting hardware and software issues.
